literal_meaning: হাত ধরে রাখা (to hold the hand)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি আমার হাত ধরে সাহায্যের অনুরোধ করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He held my hand and requested help.
The friend pleaded for forgiveness by holding my hand.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali gestures of humility and respect in making requests.
